_comentario: Contrato de estilo de Del Velo a la Vigilia (MAPS_SPEC.md §5). Fuente única de verdad del look: los mapas pintados (tools/pintar-planos.mjs) y cualquier arte generado (tools/generar-arte.mjs) pasan por estos bloques. El prompt de cada asset describe SOLO su sujeto. Cambiar el look de la crónica = editar estos bloques y regenerar.

battlemap.prefijo:
Top-down orthographic battlemap for a modern urban-horror tabletop roleplaying game (World of Darkness, Hunter: The Reckoning), set in present-day Málaga, Spain. Strict bird's-eye view looking straight down: no perspective distortion, no isometric tilt, no visible side walls on any structure.

SUBJECT:
battlemap.sufijo:
STYLE: illustrated photorealism in the manner of a professionally published modern-horror battlemap pack: crisp, confident dark ink outlines on every wall and object, filled with realistic painted materials. Cold, clinical, desaturated palette: hospital blue-greys, cold fluorescent whites gone dim, wet charcoal asphalt, grimy linoleum, steel and glass; old stone and damp medieval masonry where the place calls for it. Mean saturation low (about 8-15%), never warm or golden; the only accent colours are a deep emergency red used as a faint overall tint (never as a lit spot) and the occasional dark dried-blood stain. Nothing fantasy: no runes, no magic glow, no torches, no medieval props in modern rooms.

FLOORS: real modern floor materials drawn tile by tile — linoleum or vinyl tiles, porcelain and ceramic tiles, raised data-centre floor panels, office carpet tiles, polished concrete with expansion joints, worn parquet; old flagstones only in the convent and crypt. Where a floor has tiles, their joints follow the plan's tile pattern so the floor itself reads the grid. NEVER draw ruled or dashed grid lines on top of anything.

DETAIL: lived-in and neglected — scuff marks, wheel tracks, dust, paper scraps, water stains, grime along the skirting, damp and white salt bloom on old stone. Restrained: legible at table distance, never an all-over noisy wash.

LIGHT AND SHADOW: soft down-right drop shadows under raised objects and ambient occlusion where walls meet the floor. NEVER paint a light source, light pool, glow, halo, lens flare or god-ray — no lit lamps, no glowing screens, no emergency-light spots; every light is added dynamically in the virtual tabletop.

COMPOSITION: full bleed to all four edges, no border, no frame, no vignette, no paper margin. Strictly top-down: walls seen only as their top edge, no wall faces, no ceilings, no roofs over interiors. DOORWAYS are empty gaps with at most a faint threshold strip — never a door leaf, open or closed. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no room labels, no signage, no logos, no exit signs, no numbers, no lettering on screens, boxes, posters or floors. No compass, no scale bar, no grid, no tokens, no people, no bodies, no creatures.

retrato.prefijo:
Character portrait for a modern urban-horror tabletop RPG (World of Darkness, Hunter: The Reckoning), present-day Málaga, Spain. Head and upper chest, three-quarter view, subject facing the viewer.

SUBJECT:
retrato.sufijo:
STYLE: illustrated photorealism with confident ink linework under painted colour, like the character art of a published modern-horror sourcebook. Cold, desaturated palette — sodium-orange streetlight against hospital blue-grey shadow — with one hard, dramatic key light; contemporary clothing and grooming, believable, unglamorous, tired. Nothing fantasy, no armour, no magic glow.

BACKGROUND: a simple dark, softly out-of-focus urban backdrop (night street, clinic corridor or rain-streaked window), with no detail competing with the face.

CRITICAL: the painting bleeds to all four edges of the image. It is NOT a print on paper, NOT inside a card, NOT matted, NOT framed. No margin, no drop shadow, no torn edges.

ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT anywhere in the image: no lettering on badges, lanyards, ID cards, clothing, signage or screens; no title, caption, signature, watermark or logo. A single character only.

token.prefijo:
Top-down token artwork for a virtual tabletop (World of Darkness, Hunter: The Reckoning, present-day Málaga). ONE single person seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE, a strict bird's-eye view as if photographed from the ceiling: we see the top of the head, hair, shoulders, and the arms slightly spread or holding something; no face visible from the front, no three-quarter angle. The figure stands centered and fills about 80% of the frame.

SUBJECT:
token.sufijo:
STYLE: illustrated photorealism with confident ink outlines under painted colour, cold desaturated palette, matching the battlemaps of the same campaign. Contemporary, unglamorous clothing.

BACKGROUND: a perfectly flat, uniform, pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) background with absolutely nothing else on it: no floor, no texture, no gradient, no shadow cast on the ground, no vignette. The green must be a single flat colour so it can be keyed out.

NO text, no letters, no frame, no border, no ring, no circle, no token base, no second figure.

assets.prompt: Marcos, head of night security at a biotech clinic and a freshly turned vampire: a man about 30, Spanish, dark hair combed back with product, clean-shaven, in a well-cut dark grey suit with a lanyard and a plastic ID badge, white shirt open at the collar. Arrogant half-smile, eyes too bright and too still, skin slightly too pale, a dark smear of blood at the corner of his mouth. Behind him, out of focus, the red emergency lights of a dark hospital corridor. The illustration fills the entire image edge to edge: no paper border, no torn-paper frame, no white margin of any kind.

Sor Anunciación, a four-hundred-year-old vampire nun, prioress of a deconsecrated convent, lying in state and now rising: an ancient, gaunt woman in a worn black-and-white Spanish religious habit, face like parchment stretched over bone, lips thin and dark, eyes open, dry, utterly calm and contemptuous. Medieval stone niche behind her, an IV line taped to her wrist. Dim cold light.

Dra. Irene Salas, medical director of a biotech clinic, a ghoul addicted to vampire blood: a woman in her late forties, sharp intelligent face, grey-streaked dark hair pulled back, wire-rim glasses, a stained white lab coat over a dark blouse, bloodshot sleepless eyes, lips pressed in a guilty, clinical expression. Behind her, blurred, a surgical lamp and steel instruments.

Elías Roca, an old hunter who survived his cell: a Spanish man in his late sixties, lean and worn, deep purple shadows under the eyes, grey stubble, a cheap wool cardigan over a faded shirt, knotted scarred fingers holding a lit cigarette, a burn-scarred palm visible. Haunted, stubborn, exhausted gaze. Behind him, out of focus, a cork board covered in photos and red thread.

A 'sleeper', an anaemic clinical trial patient who has been sedated and bled for weeks: a young adult of indeterminate gender in a thin hospital gown, skin grey-pale, cracked lips, bruised needle marks on the inside of the forearm, hair matted, eyes half open and unfocused, lost. Behind them, blurred, a row of hospital beds under dim red emergency light.

A night-shift orderly of a biotech clinic who is secretly a ghoul, addicted to vampire blood: a heavyset man in his forties in pale blue scrubs with a clinic badge, unshaven, sweaty, eyes feverish and eager, teeth slightly stained, a rolled-up sleeve. Servile, nervous, dangerous. Behind him, blurred, a service corridor with a gurney.

A corporate security contractor working for a biotech company: a broad man in his thirties, buzz cut, short beard, black bomber jacket over a black polo, an earpiece, hands in gloves, impassive professional face with cold eyes. Behind him, blurred, a black SUV under a sodium streetlight on a wet street at night.

A 'chimera', a human volunteer surgically modified with vampire-derived grafts and now abandoned on the streets: a man in his twenties, feverish and sweating, hoodie pulled half back, surgical scars on the neck and temple that have not healed, dark veins spreading under the skin of the jaw, one eye reflecting light like an animal's, expression hungry and frightened. Behind him, blurred, a graffitied alley at night.

a man in a well-cut dark grey suit and white shirt, dark slicked-back hair seen from above, a lanyard with an ID badge, one hand loosely at his side, the other slightly raised with fingers spread like a predator about to grab.
an ancient gaunt nun in a black-and-white religious habit and veil seen from above, arms folded over her chest like a corpse laid in state, an IV line taped to one wrist, bony pale hands.
a woman in a stained white lab coat seen from above, grey-streaked dark hair pulled back in a bun, holding a clipboard in one hand and a syringe in the other.

an old lean man in a worn wool cardigan seen from above, grey thinning hair, holding an UNLIT red emergency flare (a plain red tube, no flame, no light, no glow) in one hand and a plastic jerrycan in the other.
a frail young patient in a thin pale hospital gown seen from above, matted hair, bare arms with bruised needle marks, barefoot, arms hanging limp.
a heavyset man in pale blue hospital scrubs seen from above, balding crown, pushing nothing but with hands raised holding a bloodied rag.
a broad man in a black bomber jacket seen from above, buzz-cut head, black gloves, holding a compact pistol in a two-handed grip pointed forward.

a young man in a dark hoodie with the hood down seen from above, sweat-dark hair, surgical scars on the neck and scalp, dark veins on the back of the neck, hands clawed, one forearm showing a bony ridge under the skin.
